description: This file contains the implementation of the CatalogViewModelService class, which is responsible for preparing and providing catalog-related data for UI views, including product listings, brands, and types. It interacts with repositories and constructs view models for displaying catalog items with filtering and pagination.

classes.name: CatalogViewModelService
classes.description: A service class that fetches catalog data, including items, brands, and types, and constructs view models for UI rendering. It implements ICatalogViewModelService and works with repositories, a URI composer, and logger.

methods.name: GetCatalogItems
methods.description: Fetches catalog items based on page, brand, and type filters, constructs a view model including pagination info.

methods.name: GetBrands
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares a list of brands for dropdown selection, adding an 'All' option.

methods.name: GetTypes
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares a list of catalog types for dropdown selection, adding an 'All' option.
